column1: Jeremy Pena leads the slate with a strong hit probability and an excellent track record of consistency, reaching safely in over 75% of games this season. He bats leadoff at home with the platoon advantage against Anthony Kay, a favorable matchup for right-handed hitters. Jake McCarthy also offers reliability atop the order with a similar hit profile and a park boost, making him a solid alternative. Luis Arraez rounds out the top options with steady contact skills and a favorable matchup.
